test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 36

questions.question: 4% of a number is approximately what percentage of 15% of the same number?
Sachin has borrowed an amount of ₹3,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 6% per annum after 2 years?
The population of a town in 1923 was 2,32,200. If its population increased in two successive decades by 30% in each decade, the population of the town in 1943 was:
The surface area (in cm2) of a sphere of radius 98 cm is: (Take π = 22/7)
The distance  between two points on a map is 7 cm. The scale of the map is 1 : 868557. The actual distance (rounded off to one decimal place) between the two points (in km) is:
The LCM of 29, 90, 180 and 261 is:
If 3584y8 is a six-digit number that is divisible by 6, what is the smallest possible value of y?

The list price of an article is ₹36,000 and a discount of 50% is offered on the list price. What additional discount percent on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to ₹1,440?
Piyush bought an article for ₹331 and sold it to Payal at a loss of 5%. With this amount, Piyush bought another article and sold it at a gain of 60%. What is Piyush's overall gain percentage?
A 298 m long train crosses a man walking at a speed of 3.8 km/hr in the opposite direction in 9 seconds. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the train?
The speed of a car is 15 metres/second. The distance (in kilometres) travelled by the car in 3 hours and 50 minutes is:
The height of a cylinder, open at the top, is 70 cm and its internal diameter is 51 cm. What is its internal surface area, in cm2 (correct to one decimal place)? (Take π = 22/7)
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 9 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 18 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?
If ₹1,001 is divided among 373 children such that each girl and each boy get ₹1 and ₹3, respectively, then how many boys are there?
The average of the first 13 multiples of 5 is:
If 2, 42, 24, and y are in proportion, then the value of y is:

The difference (rounded off to one decimal place) between the compound interest (when interest is compounded annually) and the simple interest if ₹83,300 is deposited at 3% rate of interest per annum for 2 years is:3235
In what ratio should sugar costing ₹16/kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹75/kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹60.2/kg, there is a profit of 40%?
The average age of three persons is 70 years and their ages are in proportion 1 : 5 : 9. What is the age (in years) of the youngest person?
At what annual rate of simple interest will a sum of money double in 20 years?
